subject.title: feat(control-ui): add cron calendar timeline view

question: Should maintainers sponsor a fresh or heavily rebased Control UI cron timeline implementation from this branch, or leave the linked feature issue open for a cleaner PR?
rationale: The feature is plausible and has visible proof, but the branch is stale, conflicting, and now needs product ownership plus current-main contract decisions rather than a narrow automated repair.

options.title: Request a fresh or rebased PR
options.body: Keep the feature issue open and ask for a new or heavily rebased branch against the current Cron page that preserves current contracts.

options.title: Adopt and repair this branch
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly sponsor the feature and own the rebase, status-contract, scheduler-accuracy, and i18n cleanup work.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Leave the canonical issue as backlog and stop treating this stale branch as the landing path for now.

recommendation.title: Request a fresh or rebased PR
recommendation.body: Keep the feature issue open and ask for a new or heavily rebased branch against the current Cron page that preserves current contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is primarily about the current Control UI Cron page surface after the dashboard-v2 view refactor.
